src-tauri/src/main.rs.purpose: CLI entrypoint shim; dispatches GUI mode vs CLI subcommands via winbox_gui_lib::run()

src-tauri/src/lib.rs.purpose: Tauri command handlers; AppHandle wiring; operation progress channel emit_progress; run_blocking spawn for sync ops

src-tauri/src/cli.rs.purpose: clap-based CLI; mirrors GUI commands for headless / scripted use

src-tauri/src/commands/install.rs.purpose: Profile creation: validate InstallParams, write env file (chmod 600), render compose, generate OEM scripts (Windows only)

src-tauri/src/commands/launch.rs.purpose: Container lifecycle: ensure_running (Windows/Linux dispatch), start (no-RDP), launch_rdp (xfreerdp), ensure_for_web_vnc (port for noVNC). Stale-container rm_force defensive path lives here.

src-tauri/src/commands/lifecycle.rs.purpose: pause/resume/stop/kill/restart/update/remove + set_default. update() pulls family-specific image from ImageFamily::docker_image()

src-tauri/src/commands/list.rs.purpose: Read profiles, attach connect_mode, container state, port info; consumed by list_profiles Tauri command

src-tauri/src/commands/logs.rs.purpose: Wraps docker::logs for GUI's logs modal

src-tauri/src/commands/set.rs.purpose: Settings update — recomputes compose.yml on config change

src-tauri/src/core/connect.rs.purpose: Resolves ConnectMode (Rdp / WebVnc) per profile family. Linux → WebVnc unconditionally (Phase 2 xrdp TBD)

src-tauri/src/core/compose.rs.purpose: Renders compose.yml templates per family (Windows / LinuxDistro / LinuxIso). Pinned to IMAGE_WINDOWS / IMAGE_QEMU from paths.rs. GPU passthrough block via build_gpu_block()

src-tauri/src/core/docker.rs.purpose: Docker CLI wrapper: container_status, compose_run (-p winbox-{profile}), logs, pause/unpause/stop/kill/rm_force/pull, check_kvm, check_daemon, require_installed

src-tauri/src/core/rdp.rs.purpose: Spawns xfreerdp3 with credentials from env file; stderr+stdout teed to ~/.cache/winbox/rdp-{profile}.log; HiDPI scale auto-detect via xrandr

src-tauri/src/core/paths.rs.purpose: Path constants and XDG helpers. Image pins: IMAGE_WINDOWS=dockurr/windows:5.14, IMAGE_QEMU=qemux/qemu:7.29. Cache dir for RDP logs.

src-tauri/src/core/image_family.rs.purpose: ImageFamily enum (Windows / LinuxDistro / LinuxIso) + curated SUPPORTED_DISTROS list. docker_image() returns the pinned image.

src-tauri/src/core/profile.rs.purpose: Profile registry: exists, resolve (active or first), list_names, get_default/set_default/clear_default, remove_tree

src-tauri/src/core/gpu_bind.rs.purpose: Bind/unbind GPU between vendor driver and vfio-pci at the sysfs layer

src-tauri/src/core/gpu_hooks.rs.purpose: Pre-start / post-stop lifecycle hooks (sets up vfio binding before container start, restores after stop)

src-tauri/src/core/vfio_setup.rs.purpose: System-level VFIO bring-up (modprobe, kernel params advisory)

src-tauri/src/core/snapshots.rs.purpose: qcow2-style snapshots via docker compose down + cp + up

src-tauri/src/core/health.rs.purpose: Aggregated host-health diagnostics (docker daemon, KVM, FreeRDP presence). 5 unit tests.

src-tauri/src/core/validation.rs.purpose: Input validators: profile name, BDF format, extra-port parsing, resource sizing. 4 unit tests.

src-tauri/src/core/host.rs.purpose: Host metadata (CPU model, RAM, disk free) for info banner

src-tauri/src/core/desktop.rs.purpose: Regenerate XDG .desktop launcher entries per profile

src-tauri/src/core/oem.rs.purpose: Generate Windows OEM bundle (install.bat + firstlogon.ps1) from selected bundle set

src-tauri/src/core/bundles.rs.purpose: Curated software bundles (banking-br, browsers, dev, media, office) for Windows install

src-tauri/src/core/ports.rs.purpose: Port allocation helpers (next-free for WEB / RDP / SSH per profile)

src/main.js.purpose: Frontend SPA logic in vanilla JS. ProfileCard render, modeMeta (RDP/VNC badge), search/filter, modal handlers, Tauri invoke wrappers. ~1411 lines.

src/index.html.purpose: Single page with header + dashboard + 6 modals (install, settings, logs, snapshots, reapply, confirm)

src/styles.css.purpose: Hand-rolled CSS; design tokens; modal/card/badge styling

src/i18n.js.purpose: Simple message catalog lookup with {{var}} interpolation; locale switcher

src/dom-utils.js.purpose: escapeHtml, escapeAttr, cssToken — XSS-safe DOM helpers. 3 unit tests in dom-utils.test.js.
